verses.geez: እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱሰ፡ ባሕቱ፡ ኢትኅፈር፡ ወኢታድልው፡ ለገጸ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ጌጋየ፡ ኢይኩንከ።
verses.translation: Of these things be not thou ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby:

translations.lxx: Of these things be not thou ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby:
translations.ron: Tot aşa ruşinaţi-vă de spunerea vorbelor celor din auzit şi de descoperirea cuvintelor celor ascunse.
translations.grk: μὴ περὶ τούτων αἰσχυνθῇς, καὶ μὴ λάβῃς πρόσωπον τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν·

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ሕጉ፡ ለልዑል፡ ወበእንተ፡ ሕርመትከ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ፍትሕኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኢታንጽሖ፡ ለጊጉይ።
verses.translation: of the law of the most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly;

translations.lxx: of the law of the most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly;
translations.ron: Şi aşa vei fi ruşinos adevărat şi vei afla har înaintea a tot omul.
translations.grk: περὶ νόμου ὑψίστου καὶ διαθήκης, καὶ περὶ κρίματος δικαιῶσαι τὸν ἀσεβῆ·

verses.geez: ወሶበኒ፡ ትትሓሰብ፡ ምስለ፡ ሱታፌከ፡ በእንተ፡ ተግባርከ፡ በእንተኒ፡ ሤጥ፡ ወበእንተኒ፡ ርስትከ።
verses.translation: of reckoning with thy partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends;

translations.lxx: of reckoning with thy partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends;
translations.ron: Iar de acestea să nu te ruşinezi şi nu căuta în faţă, ca să grăieşti:
translations.grk: περὶ λόγου κοινωνοῦ καὶ ὁδοιπόρων, καὶ περὶ δόσεως κληρονομίας ἑταίρων·

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ መዳልውኒ፡ ወበእንተ፡ መስፈርት፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ጥሪትከ፡ እመኒ፡ ውኁድ፡ ወእመኒ፡ ብዙኅ።
verses.translation: of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little;

translations.lxx: of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little;
translations.ron: De legea Celui Preaînalt şi de aşezământul Lui şi de judecată ca să îndreptezi pe cel nelegiuit;
translations.grk: περὶ ἀκριβείας ζυγοῦ καὶ σταθμιῶν, περὶ κτήσεως πολλῶν καὶ ὀλίγων·

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይረብሐከ፡ ወዘይበቊዐከ፡ በእንተ፡ ምህሮቶሙ፡ ለውሉድከ፡ ለገብር፡ እኩይ፡ ሥትሮ፡ ገበዋቲሁ።
verses.translation: and of merchants' indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed.

translations.lxx: and of merchants' indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed.
translations.ron: De socoteli băneşti cu prietenul sau cu tovarăşul de drum; de dreapta împărţire a moştenirii între rude;
translations.grk: περὶ ἀδιαφόρου πράσεως, καὶ ἐμπόρων, καὶ περὶ παιδείας τέκνων πολλῆς, καὶ οἰκέτῃ πονηρῷ πλευρὰν αἱμάξαι.

verses.geez: ሠናይ፡ ኀቲም፡ ላዕለ፡ ብእሲት፡ እኪት፡ ወኀበ፡ ብዙኅ፡ በዋኢቱ፡ በመዝግሕ፡ አንብር።
verses.translation: Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and locked up, where many hands are.

translations.lxx: Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and locked up, where many hands are.
translations.ron: De cumpenile şi de măsurile cele adevărate şi de câştigul celor multe şi celor puţine,
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ γυναικὶ πονηρᾷ καλὸν σφραγίς· καὶ ὅπου χεῖρες πολλαὶ, κλεῖσον.

verses.geez: ኵሎ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ በኈልቊ፡ ወበመስፈርት፡ ወበመዳልው፡ ግበር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘአባእከ፡ ወአውፃእከ፡ ወዘወሀብከ፡ ወነሣእከ፡ በመጽሐፍ፡ ይኩንከ።
verses.translation: Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that thou givest out, or receivest in.

translations.lxx: Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that thou givest out, or receivest in.
translations.ron: De câştigul din vânzare sau cumpărare, de multă certarea fiilor tăi şi de sângeroasa pedepsire a robului tău.
translations.grk: Ὃ ἐὰν παραδίδως, ἐν ἀριθμῷ καὶ σταθμῷ, καὶ δόσις καὶ λῆψις παντὶ ἐν γραφῇ.

verses.geez: ወበእንተ፡ ገሥጾቱ፡ ለአብድ፡ ወለዘ፡ አልቦ፡ ልብ፡ ወለአረጋዊኒ፡ ዘበርሥአቱ፡ ይተሉ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወትከውን፡ በአማን፡ ጠቢበ፡ ወማእምረ፡ በኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contendeth with those that are young: thus shalt thou be truly learned, and approved of all men living.

translations.lxx: Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contendeth with those that are young: thus shalt thou be truly learned, and approved of all men living.
translations.ron: La femeia rea, bună este pecetea, şi unde sunt mâini multe, încuie.
translations.grk: Περὶ παιδείας ἀνοήτου καὶ μωροῦ καὶ ἐσχατογήρου κρινομένου πρὸς νέους, καὶ ἔσῃ πεπαιδευμένος ἀληθινῶς, καὶ δεδοκιμασμένος ἔναντι παντὸς ζῶντος.

verses.geez: ወለትሰ፡ ትጋህ፡ ኅቡእ፡ ይእቲ፡ ለአቡሃ፡ ወኀልዮታ፡ ያሰርሮ፡ ለንዋሙ፡ እምንእሳ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ትልኅቅ፡ እንበለ፡ ትፍተው።
verses.translation: A daughter is a wakeful care to a father; and the care for her taketh away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated:

translations.lxx: A daughter is a wakeful care to a father; and the care for her taketh away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated:
translations.ron: Orice vei da, cu număr şi cu măsură dă, şi ce dai şi ce iei, toate scrie-le.
translations.grk: Θυγάτηρ πατρὶ ἀπόκρυφος ἀγρυπνία, καὶ ἡ μέριμνα αὐτῆς ἀφιστᾷ ὕπνον· ἐν νεότητι αὐτῆς μήποτε παρακμάσῃ, καὶ συνῳκηκυῖα μήποτε μισηθῇ.

verses.geez: ለወለት፡ እንተ፡ ኢትኅፍር፡ አጽንዕ፡ ዐቂቦታ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትረሲከ፡ ስላተ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ ወ[ነገረ]፡ ለማኅፈርከ፡ ወለማኅበረ፡ ሕዝብከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢታስተኀፍር፡ በማእከለ፡ ብዙኃን።
verses.translation: Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make thee ashamed before the multitude.

translations.lxx: Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make thee ashamed before the multitude.
translations.ron: Fata ascunsă, priveghere este tatălui şi grija ei depărtează somnul de la el, cât este tânără, ca nu cumva să-i treacă vârsta, şi după ce se mărită, să nu fie urâtă de bărbatul său;
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ θυγατρὶ ἀδιατρέπτῳ στερέωσον φυλακὴν, μήποτε ποιήσῃ σε ἐπίχαρμα ἐχθροῖς, λαλιὰν ἐν πόλει, καὶ ἔκκλητον λαοῦ, καὶ καταισχύνῇ σε ἐν πλήθει πολλῶν.

verses.geez: ኢታድሉ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ እንበይነ፡ ላሕዩ፡ ወኢትባእ፡ ማእከለ፡ አንስት።
verses.translation: Behold not everybody's beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.

translations.lxx: Behold not everybody's beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.
translations.ron: Cât este fecioară, ca nu cumva să se pângărească şi în casa părintească să rămâie grea,
translations.grk: Παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ μὴ ἔμβλεπε ἐν κάλλει, καὶ ἐν μέσῳ γυναικῶν μὴ συνέδρευε·

verses.geez: እምነ፡ ልብስ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ቊንቊኔ፡ ወእመነ፡ አንስት፡ ኵሉ፡ እኪት።
verses.translation: For from garments cometh a moth, and from women wickedness.

translations.lxx: For from garments cometh a moth, and from women wickedness.
translations.ron: Iar când va fi cu bărbatul ei ca nu cumva să se smintească,
translations.grk: ἀπὸ γὰρ ἱματίων ἐκπορεύεται σὴς, καὶ ἀπὸ γυναικὸς πονηρία γυναικός.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ እከይሁ፡ ለብእሲ፡ እምነ፡ ኂሩታ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ብእሲትኒ፡ እንተ፡ ታስተቃንእ፡ ኀፍረት፡ ይእቲ።
verses.translation: Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which bringeth shame and reproach.

translations.lxx: Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which bringeth shame and reproach.
translations.ron: Şi împreună locuind cu soţul ei să nu rămână stearpă.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων πονηρία ἀνδρὸς ἢ ἀγαθοποιὸς γυνὴ, καὶ γυνὴ καταισχύνουσα εἰς ὀνειδισμόν.

verses.geez: ወእዜከር፡ ግብሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወእነግር፡ ዘርኢኩ፡ እስመ፡ በቃሉ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: I will now remember the works of the Lord, and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of the Lord are his works.

translations.lxx: I will now remember the works of the Lord, and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of the Lord are his works.
translations.ron: Cu fata îndărătnică întăreşte paza, ca nu cumva să te faci bucurie vrăjmaşilor,
translations.grk: Μνησθήσομαι δὴ τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου, καὶ ἃ ἑώρακα ἐκδιηγήσομαι· ἐν λόγοις Κυρίου τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ፀሓይኒ፡ ያበርህ፡ ወያርኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወስብሐቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ምሉእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: The sun that giveth light looketh upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of the Lord.

translations.lxx: The sun that giveth light looketh upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of the Lord.
translations.ron: Poveste în cetate şi defăimare poporului şi înaintea multora să te ruşinezi.
translations.grk: Ἥλιος φωτίζων κατὰ πᾶν ἐπέβλεψε, καὶ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ πλῆρες τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢገብረኑ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለቅዱሳኑ፡ ከመ፡ ይንግሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ዘአጽንዐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ጽንዕ፡ በስብሐቲሁ።
verses.translation: The Lord hath not given power to the saints to declare all his marvellous works, which the Almighty Lord firmly settled, that whatsoever is might be established for his glory.

translations.lxx: The Lord hath not given power to the saints to declare all his marvellous works, which the Almighty Lord firmly settled, that whatsoever is might be established for his glory.
translations.ron: Nu căuta la tot omul pentru frumuseţe şi în mijlocul femeilor nu şedea.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐνεποίησε τοῖς ἁγίοις Κύριος ἐκδιηγήσασθαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ, ἃ ἐστερέωσε Κύριος ὁ παντοκράτωρ, στηριχθῆναι ἐν δόξῃ αὐτοῦ τὸ πᾶν.

verses.geez: ለቀላይኒ፡ ወለልብኒ፡ ይረክቦሙ፡ አሠሮሙ፡ ወያአምሮሙ፡ ምክሮሙ፡ ወያአምር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኵሎ፡ ኅሊና፡ ልብ፡ ወርእየ፡ ትእምርቶ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: He seeketh out the deep, and the heart, and considereth their crafty devices: for the Lord knoweth all that can be known, and he beholdeth the signs of the world,

translations.lxx: He seeketh out the deep, and the heart, and considereth their crafty devices: for the Lord knoweth all that can be known, and he beholdeth the signs of the world,
translations.ron: Că din haină iese molia Şi de la femeie răutatea femeii.
translations.grk: Ἄβυσσον καὶ καρδίαν ἐξίχνευσε, καὶ ἐν πανουργεύμασιν αὐτῶν διενοήθη· ἔγνω γὰρ ὁ Κύριος πᾶσαν εἴδησιν, καὶ ἐνέβλεψεν εἰς σημεῖον αἰῶνος·

verses.geez: ወዘኒ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ወዘኒ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይዜኑ፡ ወይከሥት፡ አሠረ፡ ዘኅቡእ።
verses.translation: declaring the things that are past, and for to come, and revealing the steps of hidden things.

translations.lxx: declaring the things that are past, and for to come, and revealing the steps of hidden things.
translations.ron: Mai bună este răutatea bărbatului decât femeia cea făcătoare de bine, şi decât aceea care face ruşine spre batjocură.
translations.grk: ἀπαγγέλλων τὰ παρεληλυθότα καὶ ἐπεσόμενα, καὶ ἀποκαλύπτων ἴχνη ἀποκρύφων.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘያመሥ[ጦ]፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምክር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሴውሮ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወኢአሐ[ቲ]ኒ፡(ቃል፡)፡ ።
verses.translation: No thought escapeth him, neither any word is hidden from him.

translations.lxx: No thought escapeth him, neither any word is hidden from him.
translations.ron: Îmi voi aduce dar aminte de lucrurile Domnului şi cele ce am văzut voi spune cu cuvintele Domnului.
translations.grk: Οὐ παρῆλθεν αὐτὸν πᾶν διανόημα, οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ εἷς λόγος.

verses.geez: ወአሰርገ[ወ]፡ ዕበ[ያ]፡ ለጥበቢሁ፡ እንተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ ወለዓለምኒ፡ ትሄሉ፡ ኢሂ፡ ትትዌሰክ፡ ወኢሂ፡ ተሐጽጽ፡ ወኢፈቀደ፡ ወኢአሐደ፡ መምከረ።
verses.translation: He hath garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: unto him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he hath no need of any counsellor.

translations.lxx: He hath garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: unto him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he hath no need of any counsellor.
translations.ron: Soarele luminând, peste toate priveşte şi de mărirea Domnului plin este lucrul Lui.
translations.grk: Τὰ μεγαλεῖα τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ ἐκόσμησε, καὶ ἕως ἐστὶ πρὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, οὔτε προσετέθη οὔτε ἠλαττώθη, καὶ οὐδὲ προσεδεήθη οὐδενὸς συμβούλου.

verses.geez: ወክሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ሠነይ፡ ወመፍትው፡ ወከመ፡ ብርሀን፡ ውእቱ፡ ለርእይ።
verses.translation: Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark.

translations.lxx: Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark.
translations.ron: Oare n-a dat Domnul sfinţilor ca să spună toate minunile Lui, care le-a întărit Domnul Atotştiutorul, ca să se întărească întru slava Lui toate?
translations.grk: Ὡς πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐπιθυμητὰ, καὶ ὡς σπινθῆρός ἐστι θεωρῆσαι.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕያው፡ ወይሄሉ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወይሰምዕ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘፈቀዱ።
verses.translation: All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient.

translations.lxx: All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient.
translations.ron: Adâncul şi inima le cearcă şi vicleşugurile lor le cunoaşte.
translations.grk: Πάντα ταῦτα ζῇ καὶ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐν πάσαις χρείαις, καὶ πάντα ὑπακούει.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ምክዕቢተ፡ ፩፩ቅድመ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ወኢምንተኒ፡ ዘሕጹጽ።
verses.translation: All things are double one against another: and he hath made nothing imperfect.

translations.lxx: All things are double one against another: and he hath made nothing imperfect.
translations.ron: Că a cunoscut Domnul toată ştiinţa şi a căutat la semnul veacului
translations.grk: Πάντα δισσὰ ἓν κατέναντι τοῦ ἑνὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲν ἐκλεῖπον.

verses.geez: ፩ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ አስተጻንዖሙ፡ ለሠናይ፡ ወመኑ፡ ዘይጸግብ፡ እምርእየ፡ ሠናይቱ።
verses.translation: One thing establisheth the good of another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory?

translations.lxx: One thing establisheth the good of another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory?
translations.ron: Vestind cele ce au trecut şi cele ce vor veni şi descoperind urmele celor ascunse.
translations.grk: Ἓν τοῦ ἑνὸς ἐστερέωσε τὰ ἀγαθὰ, καὶ τίς πλησθήσεται ὁρῶν δόξαν αὐτοῦ;
